feature: default-off 1..20-lane packed BF16 paged KV scatter, long NAX prefill, and stock-long Q1 read
modifications: Original project N-lane row/page geometry and one-terminal scatter extend the existing B2 private-owner contract without changing stock BF16 NAX or split-KV arithmetic. Dynamic per-row/page metadata, exact arena leases, default-off selectors, and physical dispatch counters are distinct from B2. Long read dispatch uses actual span count; Q1 stock-long scratch is bounded at 64 MiB. A separate default-off B1 selector reproduces pinned MLX architecture-s, GQA6, KV>1024 vector two-pass reduction with 128 blocks and distinct B1 partial/reduce counters; the earlier scalar B1 remains the selector-off reference. No model scheduler, serving route, or default is changed.
validation: Pure CPU C++/Python guard tests and native CMake build pass. Direct BF16 raw-byte/terminal device oracle is provided but has not run. B20 model parity, cancellation, performance, qualification, selection, and serving use remain unverified.
